description: PostDashPro is social post scheduling for AI agents: queue posts to 12 networks (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord, Mastodon) on the user's own connected accounts through each network's official API. 24 tools: ideas, media library, upload links, drafts, scheduling in the account's timezone, calendar and analytics reads. Every post is a draft or a scheduled item a person reviews before it publishes; nothing publishes instantly, no direct messages, no follower scraping.

defaultPrompt: Using only PostDashPro: which social accounts are connected to my workspace?
